description.value: Earnest Ice Cream is a values-driven Vancouver ice cream company founded in 2012, crafting small-batch scoops from local and seasonal ingredients across four city locations including this Fraser Street shop. They run a jar-return zero-waste program and rotate monthly flavours, including a selection of dairy-free vegan options made from coconut, oat, and house-made nut milks. The outdoor seating and community-facing ethos make it a welcoming stop for cyclists passing through the Fraser Street corridor.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack (3 spaces) at 8m; stands (2 spaces) at 70m. Total: 5 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Earnest Ice Cream at 3992 Fraser St is an active ice cream scoop shop with outdoor seating (corroborated by OSM outdoor_seating=yes) and toilets confirmed by OSM (toilets=yes). The FAQs page explicitly confirms vegan flavours (coconut/oat/nut milk bases) but also states 'we are not a nut-free or gluten-free facility.' No bike parking, water refill, wi-fi, or charging amenities are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags.
concerns: OSM record represents the Fraser St location but the business has four locations (Fraser St, Quebec St, Frances St, North Van); directory listing should make clear it covers 3992 Fraser St only.
Phone number from OSM (+1-604-428-0697) could not be verified from website content — only email (info@earnesticecream.com) appears there.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, well-established scoop shop on a Vancouver cycling corridor with outdoor seating, washrooms, and vegan options — a practical and pleasant stop for touring cyclists.

Packed lunches.detail: Ice cream shop only; no food beyond ice cream and toppings

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Website FAQs confirm rotating vegan flavours (dairy, egg, and honey free) made with coconut, oat, and nut milk bases. Explicitly not a gluten-free facility
